Why hire from your competitors

The best candidate for your role is already doing the job, at a company like yours. We find them, and bring them to you.

  • They've already solved your problems

    They've built similar products for the same target customers, under the same constraints. No ramp-up on the problem itself.

  • Deep domain expertise

    Years in your exact space: its hardware, its regulations, its users and its failure modes. That can't be taught in onboarding.

  • A proven track record

    What they've shipped at a direct competitor is the best evidence there is of what they'll ship for you.

  • Your competitors fall behind

    Every engineer who joins you leaves a gap on a rival's team, and takes years of know-how with them.

  • The highest pass rate

    Engineers who already do your job at a company like yours are the candidates most likely to pass your interviews.

  • The hires your recruiters won't make

    In-house talent teams often avoid approaching competitors for fear of how it looks. We do it for you, discreetly.

Every engineer you hire from a competitor accelerates your R&D and slows down your rivals.

Proven in open source

A resume says what someone claims. Open source shows what they built, how they write, and what other engineers made of it.

We read the code
An engineer reviews each candidate's public work: what they built, how hard it was, and how it was received.
Reviewed by their peers
A pull request merged into a project your team depends on has passed a review no interview can replicate.
Handpicked by our CTO
An engineer, not a keyword filter, decides who reaches you, and only sends the ones worth your team's time.

Every candidate arrives briefed

By the time you see a profile, they have agreed to interview with you, and you know what they want to earn, who else they're talking to and when they'll decide.

Already interested in you
Every candidate has told us they want to interview with your company before you see their profile.
No surprises in the final round
Target compensation, competing processes, concerns and constraints are on the table before your first call.
Your company, at its best
Every engineer we reach hears a sharp, accurate pitch for your company, which builds your reputation with the talent in your space, hired or not.

How an engagement works

  1. 01

    Deep intake

    The role, success criteria, compensation band and competitive landscape.

  2. 02

    Targeted mapping

    The relevant engineers at your competitors and peer companies, and their public work.

  3. 03

    Outreach and pre-screening

    Personalized outreach, and a technical pre-screen of everyone interested.

  4. 04

    High-signal submission

    A short list, each candidate with a full brief.

  5. 05

    Ongoing calibration

    Your feedback on every candidate sharpens the next ones.

We work on a mix of engaged and success-based models, depending on the seniority and scarcity of the role. Guarantees and replacement terms are standard.
